title: More control over chat generations
summary:
Chat gained image and video controls, Claude image URL input was fixed, and a Discord companion joined the community project directory.

Chat gained a Generation Options panel for images and video. Image controls include dimensions, seed and quality; video controls include seed, duration, aspect ratio and audio. The selected settings are sent with generation requests. Images now default to 1024×1024 with enhancement off, and chat startup falls back to a saved conversation when its previous selection is missing.

Claude requests routed through Bedrock now convert HTTP image URLs before sending them, fixing image URL input on `/v1/chat/completions`.

CloudCompile’s Lily was added to the socialBots project directory. The listing describes a conversational Discord bot that remembers user facts and relationships and chooses when to join a conversation.

highlights.title: Tune chat generations
highlights.text: Set image dimensions, seed and quality, or choose video duration, aspect ratio, seed and audio in chat’s new Generation Options panel. Your choices are passed to the generation request. [Try the playground](https://pollinations.ai/play).
